about: The introitus of the formulary “Blessed Virgin Mary of the Rosary” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Let us all rejoice in the Lord, keeping a festal day to honor the Blessed Virgin Mary, over whose solemn feast the angels rejoice and together laud the Son of God. My heart has poured forth a noble word; I recite my works to the King. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen. Let us all rejoice in the Lord, keeping a festal day to honor the Blessed Virgin Mary, over whose solemn feast the angels rejoice and together laud the Son of God.

ex.w022: The heart is pictured as pouring out words. The image presents the speaker’s inward thought becoming an utterance.
ex.w029: Ópera is plural: the speaker’s works or compositions. In this declaration to the King, it names what the speaker recites.
